Name: (EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for Ridgeside Village - BAGI Successor
Author: klhumphrey918
Description:
This mod is developed in the style of, and intended to be used alongside, the amazing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url]. By utilizing [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url], you will add custom textures in [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/cometkins/]cometkins[/url]' style for your [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] artisan good items such as honey, jelly, juice, pickles, and wine.

[u]Recommended Mods:[/u]

This mod is intended to be paired with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/LilietBorodina]LilietBorodina[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23366]Better Artisan Goods for BAGI - 1.6 assets[/url], which includes the same retextures for all vanilla items through SDV 1.6. Please visit and download that mod, as LilietBorodina's kind instructions on how to create a contact pack and recolor are what inspired me to give this a try. 

The color selections in this retexture are intended to best match up with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/StarDust0001]StarDust0001[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16617]Cuter RSV Forage and Crops Retexture[/url]﻿ mod, so I recommend you consider downloading that mod to help bring a pretty and cohesive look to all your RSV forage and crops. 

[u]Installation Instructions:[/u]

1) Install "Even Better Artisan Good Icons" mod to your mod folder. This mod is required for my content pack to function.
2) ﻿Install this mod to your mod folder.
3) Launch the game and enjoy seeing retextures that match the rest of the Better Artisan Goods art style. Enjoy!

I'm new to modding and can't really consider myself an artist...just a gal who needs all her retextures to match and wanted to share what I've done with others. 

My EBAGI retextures in cometkins style:
[list]
[*]Ridgeside Village, found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30871](EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for RSV[/url]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded, found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30850](EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for SVE[/url]
[*]Cornucopia - More Flowers, found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39727](EBAGI) Better Artisan goods for CMF[/url]
[*]Cornucopia - More Crops, found at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39803](EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for CMC[/url]﻿﻿﻿
[/list]
Thanks for taking a look, friends. Enjoy the valley!﻿ - K
